description: This is a Python source file implementing REST API routes for managing estimates and estimate items, including CRUD operations, listing, search, pagination, and server-side computation of totals, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and async session handling.

methods.name: tuple[int,int] _paginate_params(page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: Computes the offset and limit for pagination based on page and per_page parameters.

methods.name: float _get_default_rate(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Fetches the default hourly rate from settings, returning 0.0 if not available or invalid.

methods.name: float _compute_item_cost(hours: float, rate: float)
methods.description: Calculates the total cost for an estimate item based on hours and rate.

methods.name: None _compute_totals(session: AsyncSession, estimate: Estimate)
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the total hours and total cost for an estimate, based on its items.

methods.name: list_estimates( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search text over name/client"), page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), per_page: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of estimates with optional search filtering.

methods.name: create_estimate(payload: EstimateCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Creates a new estimate with optional items and computes total hours and cost.

methods.name: get_estimate(estimate_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a single estimate by ID, including its items.

methods.name: update_estimate( estimate_id: int, payload: EstimateUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session) )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing estimate and recomputes totals.

methods.name: delete_estimate(estimate_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Deletes an estimate and its items.

methods.name: add_item( estimate_id: int, payload: EstimateItemCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Adds a new item to an estimate and recalculates totals.

methods.name: update_item( estimate_id: int, item_id: int, payload: EstimateItemUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Updates an existing estimate item and recalculates totals.

methods.name: delete_item( estimate_id: int, item_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Removes an estimate item and recomputes totals.
